## Description

Exploits immediate price disparities across three currency pairs on a single or across multiple cryptocurrency exchanges (e.g. BTC/USD -&gt; ETH/BTC -&gt; ETH/USD).

## Where it may fit

High market volatility, fragmented liquidity across crypto venues, rapid price movements causing lagged order book adjustments.

## Vehicles

Crypto proprietary trading firms, digital asset quantitative funds, HFT market makers.

## Required data

Sub-millisecond L2/L3 order book streams, WebSocket quote depth for exchange trading pairs.

## Caveats

Extremely sensitive to taker trading fees, withdrawal fees across venues, and WebSocket network latency.
